name: dflash2-f16
description: First speculation candidate: Hipfire's dflash speculation with a DFlash2 F16 drafter. Identical prompt, identical sampling, identical max_tokens as the AR row -- only the decode path differs. Requires -before-engine to load the drafter and switch the daemon.

identity_probe.note: `model` is the RESOLVED artifact the server reports at /health, which is not the alias used to serve it: this rig serves `qwen3.8:27b-fast` and /health answers `qwen3.8:27b-mq4-xt`. Guessing the alias here recreates a five-minute false readiness timeout. Hipfire's health payload does not expose speculation state, so this attests the resolved target only; the speculation arm is attested by the preparation log's config dump.

experiment.notes: DFlash speculation with a DFlash2 F16 drafter. Drafter quant is a separate axis; see the draft-quant family.
